changes: New "Capture separator sheet" rule for batches and documents — print a ready-made Document or Batch separator sheet from More ▸ Separator sheets and use it to split scans without designing or configuring a barcode.
Yes/No index fields (Boolean format) now edit as a checkbox in the review panel and Table mode. A blank value stays unanswered, so a mandatory Yes/No field is still flagged until someone answers it.
Yes/No values are read the same way everywhere (yes/no, true/false, 1/0), including when exporting to a Therefore logical field.
About now includes this version history.
Re-picking a Therefore category with a different number keeps field mappings by matching field names — useful after importing a configuration from another Therefore system.
A Therefore export no longer reports failure when a workflow moves the new document to another category straight after it's saved.
Fixed Statistics tooltips and Table/Preview column widths.
An import failure that was previously silent is now logged.
Edit index fields directly in Table mode, moving between cells with Tab and Shift+Tab.
Displayed batch numbers restart each session.
Manual batches show status indicators instead of status text.
A first-run setup wizard helps configure Capture the first time it starts.
Fixed document status when no capture profile is applied.
Aligned the Statistics chart.
Remove blank pages automatically on ingestion.
Rotate pages from the page strip.
New REST export, and PDF/A output.
Fixed the capture profile picker.
New Statistics window.
Records when each document was last exported.
Undo for page delete, split and reorder.
Drag to reorder rules and exports, and copy an export to another document type.
Batch-aware scanning and importing, and Trash management.
Drag pages to reorder them, including to the last position.
Drag to reorder document types; removing one now asks for confirmation.
A None entry in the capture profile picker.
Hidden index fields are grouped at the bottom of the field list.
Fixed oversized pages from scanned or imported documents, and a crash with single-page scans or non-PDF imports.
Removed the Therefore export's Fixed/Constant value mapping option.
Updated in-app Help, with more detail on scripting.
Fixed scripting in the packaged macOS app.
Script errors now show the underlying cause instead of a generic initialisation failure.
Empty fields are left out of Therefore exports so Therefore's own field defaults apply.
Grab field values straight from the document image in Preview mode.
"Apply profile" reclassifies selected documents under another capture profile.
"Export selected to PDF" for ad hoc exports.
Scan or import with no capture profile selected (Unsorted).
AI-extracted values are located and highlighted on the page where possible.
Table view fixes for selection, scrolling and column widths.
The field editor is split into General, Extraction and Scripting tabs, and the field list can be resized.
Fixed Therefore export failing with a date/time error.
Fixed input field text alignment and control heights.
Faster processing: OCR runs in parallel and reloads do less work.
Capture configuration rebuilt around unified Capture Profiles.
Search added to in-app Help, plus app-wide UI fixes.
